note: On the third batch: ProofCouncil solved nine of ten problems to a standard judges deemed acceptable with minor revisions, while the best open-weight system, built on Kimi K3, solved none. Abouzaid says the gap between open-weight and frontier models is much larger in research mathematics than in other domains, and that proving well-defined statements may soon not be worth testing on frontier models. First Proof only tests publicly available systems, so OpenAI's newest internal model was excluded.
title: New ‘First Proof’ exam reveals how AI-powered math is a pay-to-play sport
